name: [V404 CHAR] Undertale Soul OPs: Replicated
desc:
A replicated Soul OPs 1.

Formerly known as "Charles OPs" by charleschieng, game was overtaken.
But credit to him, he's the goat. Most of the characters in this game are made by him.

This game was made a long time ago so expect it to not have all of the updated contents from the original game.

Also, this game isn't finished. The original game was NOT made by me or Charles. This is just a replicated version.

I'm not planning to make profit off this game.
As mentioned above, all paid characters will be free including private servers

The original game was made by Oyun, TheChickenLord and their friends.
This game icon by Rux.
Hotlands and Deltarune map were made by Gen, as well as "INSTABILITY" badge icon.
More credits on their game page. Game link below if you want to check it out.
